name: MotionKit Liquid Glass
tagline: Glass that bends light for real.
pitch: A rebuilt glass renderer. You shape the edge, set the index of refraction, and the background refracts, magnifies and splits into colour exactly where real glass would.
requires: After Effects CC 2015 or newer,Multi-Frame Rendering needs AE 2022+
features: Real refraction
Convex Lens, Smooth Dome, Chamfer, Concave or Flat edges, bent through an actual 3D surface.
True colour dispersion
Red, green and blue refract at their own index, so fringes appear only on the steep edge.
Any shape becomes glass
Assign a star, logo, text layer or precomp as the Track Layer and it gets the full bevel.
Blob merge + liquid motion
Shapes B and C melt into the main shape; Wobble animates the edge like living liquid.
A full lighting kit
Glare, sheen, inner shadow, rim colour, tint and environment reflections.
32-bit, multi-frame ready
8, 16 and 32-bit float, Multi-Frame Rendering in AE 2022 and newer.

name: MotionKit Masker
tagline: Select it. Refine it. Bake it. Done.
pitch: Put the Target Point on an object and MotionKit Masker isolates it from PNGs, JPGs, stills and footage without drawing a single Bézier point, then bakes the result into normal After Effects masks.
requires: After Effects,Works best where the object has a clear colour or brightness edge
features: One-click object selection
Place the Target Point over the object. Color Range and Edge Protection do the rest.
Multiple regions, real holes
Designs made of separate pieces stay whole; openings and enclosed areas stay cut out.
Refinement controls
Cleanup, Expand / Contract, Edge Feather, Fill Enclosed Holes and Matte Contrast.
Preview modes
Switch between Cutout, Matte, Selection Overlay and Original while you refine.
I'm Done - Bake Mask
Converts the result into standard After Effects masks and switches itself off for smooth playback.
Local and private
Runs on your machine and never uploads a frame. Center Anchor to Mask included.

name: MotionKit Mosaic MAX
tagline: Mosaic and blur that knows which layers to leave alone.
pitch: Drop it on an adjustment layer, pick your layers and give each one a mode: Include puts the effect only on that layer, Exclude keeps that layer sharp. Mix them freely: censor a tracked face, keep the title that crosses it.
platforms: macOS (Apple Silicon + Intel, notarised by Apple) · Windows 10 / 11
features: Up to 12 layer slots
Set How Many and exactly that many pickers appear. Include or Exclude each one.
Follows everything
Parenting, 3D layers through the comp camera, opacity and in/out points are all respected.
Shape per layer
Alpha, Luma, Bounding Box or Bounding Ellipse: an instant face censor.
Lock Grid to a layer
Cells move, scale and rotate with your subject instead of crawling across it.
Styles and cells
Mosaic, Blur or both. Square, Hexagon, Triangle or Brick cells, plus Cell Gap for an LED-wall look.
Fast
Multithreaded, 8/16/32-bpc, and it only renders the area that changes: small regions up to 10× faster.

name: MotionKit Grid
tagline: Framing grids, layout guides and tracked overlays.
pitch: A native grid you can drag by its corners, run out to the frame edges, lock to a moving layer and dress with markers at every intersection. Every line setting is animatable.
features: Build the grid your way
Corner-point handles or Width / Height sliders, columns and rows up to 200.
Lines that leave the box
Run them out to the frame edges or extend them by a set amount: a real framing guide.
Tracks a layer, frame by frame
Locks to a layer's edges and follows its animation, no keyframes to set.
Keep Subject Clear
Mattes the grid out wherever your subject is, so the mesh sits around it, not on it.
Markers at every intersection
Square, diamond, triangle, plus, ring, circle, or any layer: logos, icons, whatever you want.
Animatable styling
Line width, colour and opacity, plus marker size, colour, opacity and rotation.

name: MotionKit Glow
tagline: Exponential glow without the render hit.
pitch: A lightning-fast glow for After Effects: rich exponential falloff, sweeping light and cinematic chromatic fringing at any radius.
features: Exponential falloff
Layered bloom that stays hot in the core and fades naturally, like light does.
Chromatic fringing
Cinematic colour separation at the edges of the glow.
Any radius, fast
GPU accelerated, so huge glows do not stall your previews.
Colour accurate
16-bit and 32-bit float projects stay clean.

name: MotionKit Command Console
tagline: Tell After Effects what you want.
pitch: Press your shortcut, type it, hit Enter. deepglow red, blur 50, stagger 3, solid red 1080x1080: 60+ commands that understand what you mean, on Mac and Windows.
features: Effects that know what comes next
deepglow red adds Deep Glow with a red tint and switches the tint on. Already on the layer? It updates it.
60+ commands
solid, text, camera, circle, null, stagger, trim, speed, freeze, marker, ease, wiggle, loop, expr and more.
Say it either way
50 opacity or opacity 50. Chain with &. Save anything as a macro.
Never guess the syntax
help lists everything; type a command without numbers and it shows how it is written. Tab fills an example.
It finally feels right
A real spring on open, a highlight that glides between results, and it never steals Enter from a habit.
Signed on Mac
macOS 11+, signed and notarised by Apple. Windows 10 / 11 with high-DPI and every keyboard layout.

name: MotionKit Web To AE
tagline: Any web page, as editable After Effects layers.
pitch: Not a screenshot, not a trace. Headlines arrive as real text layers with their fonts, cards and buttons as real shape layers with bezier paths, named, colour-labelled and parented like the page.
platforms: Any Chromium browser on macOS or Windows
requires: Chrome, Edge, Brave or Arc,MotionKit Pro 8.0.0+ open in After Effects
features: Real text, not pixels
Font, weight, size, tracking, leading and colour intact: retype it, animate it, restyle it.
True vector shapes
Cards, buttons and containers as shape layers where each corner keeps its own radius.
Pixel-perfect placement
Layers land by baseline, so nothing shifts even when a font substitutes.
Full layer hierarchy
Named after their elements, colour-labelled by type and parented to their containers.
Smart font handling
Tells you which web fonts will substitute and lets you pick the replacement before you build.
Send from anywhere, privately
Floating button, toolbar or Alt+Shift+A. Captures only travel to 127.0.0.1, your own machine.

name: MotionKitBrowser
tagline: A real browser in your editor, and it feels like Chrome.
pitch: Browse, stream tutorials and pull references without leaving your comp. 2.0 looks and moves like Google Chrome, and your tabs follow you between After Effects and Premiere Pro.
requires: After Effects and/or Premiere Pro,macOS 12 or newer,Windows: Microsoft Edge WebView2 (built into Windows 11)
features: Looks and moves like Chrome
Curved tabs, a pill address bar with suggestions, menus, drag to reorder, reopen closed tab (⇧⌘T), bookmarks (⌘D).
Tabs follow you
Open a tab in After Effects and it appears in Premiere Pro, same order, same active tab. Switch it off per app.
The sites you actually need
Pexels, Unsplash, Google, Instagram and YouTube load as real pages, and you stay signed in.
One sign-in on Mac
Log in once: the After Effects panel and the MotionKitBrowser app share their logins.
One voice
Video sound follows the app you are using, so a tab open in both never plays twice.
A start page for editors
A Chrome-style search box, pinned tiles and 84 editor bookmarks in 12 categories.

name: MotionKit Downloader
pitch: A dedicated download engine for MotionKit Pro and Flex ULTIMATE. Paste a link in your panel: it downloads at full speed, lands in your project and is ready to edit.
platforms: macOS (Apple Silicon or Intel, notarised) · Windows (x64 + ARM64)
requires: For panel hand-off: MotionKit Pro 9.0.2+ or Flex ULTIMATE 2.0.4+ (optional)
features: Connected to both panels
Paste a link in the Downloader tab of MotionKit Pro or Flex ULTIMATE; the file comes straight back into your project.
Built for speed
Up to 32 parallel connections into one file. Idle ones take over the slow parts, so it never sits at 99%.
Downloads that finish
New in 2.1: dropped Wi-Fi or a Mac waking from sleep is ridden out for up to two minutes, then it carries on.
4K and 2K that open in your editor
VP9 and AV1 become H.264 on your hardware encoder. Prefer the untouched original? One toggle.
Any link
YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Vimeo, X, Facebook, Reddit, Twitch and more, plain file links, and your browser’s cookies for sites that need a sign-in.
A library and a browser extension
Every file sorted into Video, Audio, Images and more; Chrome, Edge and Brave hand their downloads over too.
